note: Recorded by hand from data/pages/awscloudtrail__latest__userguide__cloudtrail-supported-regions.md before the parser was written. Counted the data rows of the single Region table: 36 rows, read top to bottom from the 'Region' column (the Region code), not from the endpoint hostname. All 36 codes exist in regions.json, so nothing is unresolved. The 10 Regions in regions.json that the table never names (ap-east-2, ap-southeast-6, eu-isoe-west-1, eusc-de-east-1, us-iso-east-1, us-iso-west-1, us-isob-east-1, us-isob-west-1, us-isof-east-1, us-isof-south-1) are simply absent: the page never says CloudTrail is unavailable there, so they are not exclusions and derivation stays 'enumerated'. The note box pointing at CloudTrail Lake supported Regions and at the General Reference data plane endpoints, and the two closing paragraphs pointing at the GovCloud (US) User Guide and the China endpoints guide, are pointers to other guides, not coverage; us-gov-east-1, us-gov-west-1 and cn-north-1 are counted because they each have their own table row, not because of those paragraphs. No row carries a carve-out, so every row is 'full' and there are no partials.
